title: Why Do We Need Sleep?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Need Sleep.
Your brain files memories while you rest.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Your body repairs little wear and tear.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
That is why sleep helps you learn tomorrow.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Sleep is not wasted time.
The pictures today are a new moon world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we need sleep.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
